mechanism: Hydrocortisone may antagonize the antihypertensive effects of guanfacine through mineralocorticoid activity and sodium retention, while guanfacine's CNS effects may be potentiated by concurrent corticosteroid use.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely during concurrent use; guanfacine dosage adjustment may be necessary, and consider alternative antihypertensive agents if hydrocortisone is used chronically at higher doses.
